critical_code_review_comments: Hero section root element does not carry a data-testid='hero' attribute. The hero content + per-stat testids exist (hero-stat-*), but adding a top-level data-testid='hero' on the hero <section> would make automated smoke tests cleaner. Low priority.

CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec — already flagged in iteration_1, still present. Browsers will silently reject credentialed requests if any ever happen. Low priority while no auth exists.

Three.js console warnings on every render: 'THREE.Clock deprecated' and 'PCFSoftShadowMap deprecated' — non-blocking but noisy. Worth migrating to THREE.Timer / current shadow map enum at the next dependency bump.

GET /api/inquiries (and /api/dealers, /api/samples) are public, unauthenticated, and list every submission. Fine for an MVP / non-PII brochure site, but if these endpoints ever get linked from the UI or indexed, names+emails+phones leak. Recommend an admin token guard before launch.

fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task(send_email_async(...)) calls do not attach an exception handler. With Resend disabled they only log, but once enabled an exception inside the task (outside the try/except) would be silently swallowed by the event loop. Wrap with task.add_done_callback(lambda t: t.exception() and logger.error(...)).
